tolerance.note: 0.5% of the outlet temperature in C is about 0.2 K; the packages differ in water liquid enthalpy, so the spread across packages is reported

scenarios.why: swap the two flows (50 kg/s cold, 100 kg/s hot): the same independent enthalpy balance gives 332.0199 K, so the temperature moves toward the larger stream
equal flows of 100 kg/s: the independent balance gives 324.0193 K and the mass flow is 200 kg/s

review.method: expected temperatures recomputed independently with CoolProp (IAPWS-95) from the enthalpy balance; mass balance exact
